name: Arc Browser
why_interesting: Arc represents the most radical reimagining of browser UX in decades. While built on Chromium, it completely reinvents the browser interface with vertical tabs, Spaces for context switching, Little Arc for quick tasks, and native split-view multitasking. The Browser Company treats the browser as an operating system for the web, introducing concepts like Easels for visual note-taking and Boosts for user-controlled website customization. Arc challenges every assumption about browser design while maintaining compatibility with existing web standards.
key_innovations: Vertical sidebar tabs replacing horizontal tab bar
Little Arc mini-browser for ephemeral tasks
Command bar as primary navigation interface
Easels for capturing and annotating web content
Boosts for customizing any website's appearance
Pinned tabs and favorites organizational hierarchy
target_audience: Power users seeking better tab management
Designers and creatives needing visual workflows
Users overwhelmed by traditional browser tab sprawl
